paper.citation: Abadie, A., and L’Hour, J. (2021). A Penalized Synthetic Control Estimator for Disaggregated Data. Journal of the American Statistical Association, 116(536), 1817–1834. DOI:10.1080/01621459.2021.1971535
paper.title: A Penalized Synthetic Control Estimator for Disaggregated Data
paper.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper.source_version: Published Table4 baseline100/400; author v3 commit3f2ad93a96acd558841275d07cd70576c78d451f default100/1000 differs; approved n extension retained.
paper.source_locator: Published PDF: Section 5, PDF p.8/journal p.1824 (unnumbered DGP), PDF p.9/journal p.1825 (sample sizes), Table 4 PDF p.13/journal p.1829. Author simulations/Main_MonteCarlo_v3.m commit 3f2ad93a96acd558841275d07cd70576c78d451f, lines 33–37,69–81,205–219.

mechanism.name: Two-period nonlinear-covariate panel with a zero treatment effect

generation_equations.label: fixed strata and sample-size interface
generation_equations.expression: n is units; n1=min(n-1,max(1,floor(n/5+0.5))), n0=n-n1; baseline n=500 gives n1=100,n0=400. Other n are sample_size_extension_not_paper_table4. G_i=1 for first n1 units and 0 otherwise.

generation_equations.label: covariates
generation_equations.expression: p=4,r=2,a=0.1,b=0.9,h=0.1; X_ij|G_i=1 iid Uniform(a,b); X_ij|G_i=0=sqrt(U_ij), U_ij iid Uniform(0,1). Independent across units and covariate coordinates.

generation_equations.label: observed two-period outcomes
generation_equations.expression: Y_pre_i=mu_i+epsilon_pre_i; Y_post_i=mu_i+epsilon_post_i; all period/unit errors iid N(0,1), independent of X. The same X is shared across periods. A_pre=0,A_post=G; treatment_effect=0.

generation_equations.label: causal target
generation_equations.expression: ATT_post=E[Y_2(1)-Y_2(0)|G=1]=0; holding the same post error fixed across intervention states gives finite-sample SATT=0.

sampling.unit: Independent units in fixed treated/control strata; two observations per unit represented by one wide row.
sampling.dependence: Shared four baseline covariates within unit; independent standard-normal period disturbances. Covariates iid within strata and across dimensions; no missingness or attrition.

assumptions: Consistency, no interference and no anticipation; A_pre=0 and A_post=G.
Shared time-invariant unit signal and independent mean-zero period disturbances imply parallel untreated mean trends; zero treatment response is a structural DGP restriction.

properties.notes: Four squared covariates enter additively; no products across covariates. G is the fixed stratum indicator.

estimand.name: ATT_post
estimand.definition: E[Y_2(1)-Y_2(0)|G=1] in the treated covariate population. Equal-weight finite-sample treated SATT also equals zero pointwise.

parameters.rng: Python random.Random, independent sequential normal draws; not MATLAB bitwise replay

truth.expression: E[Y_2(1)-Y_2(0)|G=1] in the treated covariate population. Equal-weight finite-sample treated SATT also equals zero pointwise.
truth.derivation: Pointwise post-period treatment-response cancellation gives ATT=SATT=0. Independent rational Simpson integration verifies treated-population normalization, separately from generator arithmetic.

adaptations: Baseline follows published Table 4 (100 treated/400 controls); author v3 default is 100/1000 and is not claimed as the baseline.
External n counts units; other n follow the explicitly documented deterministic approximately 1:4 allocation and are sample-size extensions.
Seven observed columns in a unit-wide representation; Python local RNG preserves the specified distributions, not MATLAB random-stream identity. No estimator or Table 4 performance replication.
warnings: No explicit latent-variable metadata or reliably identifiable latent declarations; absence from this list does not prove that no latent variables exist.
Catalog placement: Two-period treated-group panel from a penalized synthetic-control study; the design may also be used for DiD.
